items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: Gene had Roy Eldridge in his band for years

ctx.x: Oh that was the 40s. You can’t imagine that today, actually. Terrible. But they didn’t have that kind of, they couldn’t stay in the same hotels, they had to have them in the section of town where they could stay. Some of them stayed like in boarding houses. So but there was no extended stays on that tour. So once in a while we’d stay over because the next jump wasn’t that far. But that was the way it was back then. And even though like Gene had Roy Eldridge in his band for years, that was before that time in the…
You eventually got — did you get tired of the road?
